name: Dongsung “Donny” Kim
biography: Dongsung (Donny) Kim is an IT-Security expert at Security Office part of Truesec. Their software interests vary widely from frontend to DevSecOps, with research interests spanning from reverse engineering to web security. Equipped with both professional and academic experience, they want to reconcile two seemingly opposite ideas: understanding user-facing software problems without compromising security.
